cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. We wanted somewhere to belong. This leaking cottage can still be ours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The roof needs replacing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then we'll know every tile of the place we belong.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It may cost our savings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We hoped for a home, not an untouched savings account beside someone else's house.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Take my good teacup. It'll remind you of our afternoons wherever you end up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why would I end up elsewhere?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Someone as capable as you must have wonderful doors waiting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you asking me to leave?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm making sure you won't mistake this doorway for your last opportunity.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem

cards.title: Everything Has Two Prices
cards.instruction: Price every offer twice: once in practical terms and again through an emotional cost that grows when the offer returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The lift costs petrol and a proper conversation about why you stopped calling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay for petrol.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Good. That gets the car moving, not us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we discuss it another day?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then today costs petrol and another postponed conversation. The second price is rising.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Make it the biggest one, then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. The word 'one' has retained its dignity.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You said 'nothing can go wrong' before balancing the key on the teacup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It fell into the cup. I dried it with the invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. And now the invitation has dissolved around the key to the wedding hall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can still prise it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Your 'nothing' has become both the lock and the address we can't read.

beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember calling the spare chair unnecessary before giving its place to the cake?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake needed somewhere flat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the guest sat on the piano stool, and you moved the pianist to the window.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's managed perfectly well.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until we open that window to cool the cake. Every sensible decision is now sitting on the next one.
